svg.title: How the tutor's mind and memory work per chat turn
svg.desc: A cycle: the mind's three stores are read into every prompt, the tutor replies, a cheap extraction call writes new signals back into the stores, and the updated mind streams to the student's panel. Assessments feed mastery with stronger weight.
svg.text: e.g. “I always mix up V = IR”

g.text: learning style: visual; struggles with algebra…”

svg.text: uses the student’s style + RAG curriculum
5 · THE MIND — three Postgres stores, per student
